messages:
lee: Heads-up team: final pen-test from CypherAudit landed in today. Highlights: service account misbind allowed lateral RBAC escalation, KMS audit sampling disabled on one keyring, and several service-to-service auth failures not logged. We need a tight remediation + evidence packaging run and lock a retest slot. Can we triage owners?

ara: I can take the RBAC remediation. Plan to do least-privilege adjustments and remove the broad `roles/editor` binding from the infra service account. Will create a scoped role and do a canary attach.

vikram: I'll own KMS audit collection. Need to confirm cloud provider: some keys are GCP, some are AWS CMEK. I'll pull both audit trails. Also will check key rotation history and rewraps.

jamie: I'll package artifacts and produce the manifest+checksums and notarize via GPG. Where should I put the bucket? read-only with restricted access.

ops-oncall: Accepting standby for the change window. If the change impacts control plane, page SRE immediately. Have rollback steps prepared.

morgan: Suggested window: Fri 2024-09-13 14:00 UTC -> 90m. We need: pre-change snapshots (IAM + key metadata), the change, monitoring, evidence capture, and sealed upload. Vendor wants evidence sealed (no edits) and operator signatures.

ara: RBAC plan (canary-first): 1) Snapshot current bindings: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy $PROJECT --format=json > pre-iam.$TS.json` 2) Create custom role `infra.limited` with only required perms 3) Attach to `svc-infra-canary@` 4) Monitor 30m metrics (errors, 5xxs, auth failures) 5) Roll remainder.

ara: terraform preview snippet I'll include in PR; sample minimal role: ```hcl
resource "google_project_iam_custom_role" "infra_min" {
  role_id = "infra_min"
  title   = "Infra Minimal Role (PT fix)"
  permissions = [
    "compute.instances.get",
    "storage.objects.get",
  ]
}
```

vikram: KMS exports: GCP KMS audit (Cloud Audit Logs) + IAM bindings, AWS CloudTrail for KMS. Commands: GCP: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_cluster" OR protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com"' --freshness=45d --format=json > kms-gcp-45d.ndjson` AWS: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-08-01 --end-time 2024-09-13 --query Events > kms-aws-45d.json`

vikram: Will also export key metadata: `gcloud kms keys describe $KEY --location=global --keyring=$RING --format=json` and `aws kms describe-key --key-id $KEY_ID`.

jamie: Packaging: I'll create a bucket `gs://redwood-pt-evidence-4143` with `uniform` bucket-level access, object owner forced. Artifacts will be write-once via lifecycle lock: objects uploaded once, then ACLs removed. Each file will have a sha256 and we'll include the capture command in README. Example: `sha256sum kms-gcp-45d.ndjson > kms-gcp-45d.ndjson.sha256`

jamie: I'll also generate a signing packet: `gpg --armor --local-user 0xABCD1234 --output kms-gcp-45d.ndjson.sig --detach-sign kms-gcp-45d.ndjson` and store public key fingerprint in the manifest.

morgan: Compliance asks that we do not rotate or rewrap keys before evidence capture. Vikram, confirm you will not run any destructive key operations during the window.

vikram: Confirmed: no rotations or rewraps until after evidence snapshot. If a rotation is absolutely required, it will be scheduled and recorded; we will not perform it during evidence capture.

ops-oncall: Quick rollback plan for RBAC: reapply `pre-iam.$TS.json` via `gcloud projects set-iam-policy $PROJECT pre-iam.$TS.json`. For terraform-managed state we will snapshot the remote state and keep a `rollback-state` branch.

ara: Monitoring checks: set up a short-term policy to alert on `log_name="projects/*/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity" AND protoPayload.methodName: "SetIamPolicy"` and `metric` for increased `PERMISSION_DENIED` on services. If errors > 5% baseline for 10m -> auto rollback.

qa-bot: Vendor retest scheduler: CypherAudit requested next available slot after remediation. Proposed: Fri 2024-09-13 16:00 UTC for retest (2hr). If we accept, I will block vendor slot and send signed evidence upload details.

morgan: Accept proposed retest time. Jamie, plan to upload sealed evidence and give vendor presigned GET links. Use object versioning turned on so uploads are immutable.

jamie: Will enable versioning and object lock with `gsutil retention` and post presigned URLs: `gsutil signurl -d 7d /path/to/key.json gs://redwood-pt-evidence-4143/*` — I'll include one-time tokens for vendor.

vikram: Evidence manifest fields: filename, sha256, capture-command, operator, timestamp, signature-fingerprint, key-metadata-file (if applicable). Example entry: `kms-gcp-45d.ndjson, <sha256>, gcloud logging read ..., jamie, 2024-09-13T14:32:00Z, 0xABCD1234, keymeta-prod-keyring.json`

morgan: Also we need to keep an audit-chain: who executed commands (use `sudo` logs, shell history hashed, and recorded session via `tlog` or auditd`). Jamie add a `session-recordings/` folder and list session IDs in manifest.

jamie: Will store `tlog` session IDs and redact PII, but include operator identity. We'll also embed `sha256(session-recording)` in manifest.

vendor-bot: CypherAudit: please provide uploader credentials and the vendor PGP key fingerprint to receive signed evidence. We'll verify signatures on receipt.

morgan: Jamie, please confirm vendor key and presume we will only provide read access to sealed bucket and ephemeral presigned links. Also include `readme.md` with commands and operator notes.

jamie: Confirmed. I will place `README_FOR_VENDOR.md` with the manifest and contact for signature verification.

ops-oncall: Final checklist before Fri 14:00 UTC:
- ara: PR + terraform plan + pre-iam snapshot (owner: ara)
- vikram: KMS exports + key metadata + confirm no rotations (owner: vikram)
- jamie: evidence bucket + upload scripts + signatures + presigned links (owner: jamie)
- morgan: vendor coordination + retest booking (owner: morgan)
- ops-oncall: rollback ready and pager rotation (owner: ops-oncall)

lee: Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept and will be present during the window. If anyone cannot attend, call it out now so we can reschedule.

ara: :white_check_mark:

vikram: :white_check_mark:

jamie: :white_check_mark: Will upload initial artifacts after we snapshot pre-change state.

ops-oncall: :white_check_mark:

morgan: :white_check_mark: I'll follow up with calendar invite and vendor connection details. Keep this thread for live notes and final manifest link after upload.
